ordo.legal: Prescription-only medicines are dispensed solely on presentation of the original prescription. This platform puts people in contact: it does not sell medicines and handles no payment.

legal.avertissement: This platform does not replace the official emergency services.
legal.quoiTexte: It puts a person who needs care in contact with the health workers, pharmacies and health centres in their area. It gives no medical advice, sells nothing and handles no payment.
legal.donneesTexte: Your phone number is never shown publicly. It is passed only to the health worker who accepts your request. Prescription photos and voice messages are accessible only to the recipients and the moderators, and are deleted automatically after {jours} days.
legal.verificationTexte: A health worker who signs up is visible immediately marked “Self-declared”: they can help without waiting. The administration has {probation} days to check their qualification and give them the “Verified” badge. After that time without verification, the listing is withdrawn from the public.
legal.numerosTexte: Some numbers shown come from public sources that contradict each other and have not been confirmed by an official Chadian source. They are marked “to be confirmed”. If in doubt, call the verified health facilities first.

signal.envoye: Report sent to the moderators. Thank you.
